services.name: static-site-storage
services.purpose: Hosts the static marketing website files (HTML, CSS, JS, images)

services.name: cdn
services.purpose: Content delivery network to cache and serve website content globally over HTTPS

services.name: dns
services.purpose: DNS resolution for the custom domain pointing to the CloudFront distribution

services.name: tls-cert
services.purpose: Provisions and manages the SSL/TLS certificate used for HTTPS on the CDN

dependencies.description: CloudFront pulls and caches content from the S3 origin
Route 53 routes the custom domain to the CloudFront distribution
CloudFront uses the ACM certificate to terminate HTTPS connections

ingress: HTTPS (443) from the internet to CloudFront distribution
HTTP (80) redirected to HTTPS at CloudFront
network.notes: S3 bucket is not publicly accessible directly; access is restricted to CloudFront via Origin Access Control (OAC). All public traffic terminates at CloudFront over HTTPS.

ambiguities.detail: The description does not specify a custom domain name or whether Route 53 should manage an existing domain.
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed a custom domain is desired and Route 53 will be used to manage DNS records pointing to CloudFront.

ambiguities.detail: No AWS region was specified for resource deployment.
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed us-east-1, since ACM certificates for CloudFront must be requested in us-east-1.

ambiguities.detail: The description does not specify how CloudFront should access the S3 origin securely.
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed use of CloudFront Origin Access Control (OAC) with a bucket policy restricting direct public S3 access.

ambiguities.detail: The description does not specify how static files are built, versioned, or uploaded to S3.
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed static files are pre-built and uploaded manually or via a separate out-of-scope process; no CI/CD pipeline is included.

ambiguities.detail: The description does not specify how the TLS certificate should be validated.
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed DNS validation via Route 53 for the ACM certificate.

ambiguities.detail: No caching policy, TTLs, or invalidation strategy were specified for the CDN.
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed default CloudFront caching behavior with standard TTLs suitable for static content.

ambiguities.detail: The description does not specify which IaC tool to use for provisioning.
ambiguities.assumption: Assumed Terraform as the sole provisioning tool; no Kubernetes, Helm, Jenkins, or Ansible components are needed for this static site architecture.
